newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland not to recall envoy in Tehran for now.
newsitem.headline: Poland not to recall envoy in Tehran for now.

text.p: Poland has not had an ambassador in Iran for months and will not for now join Western countries which are recalling their envoys, its foreign ministry said on Friday.

The European Union, which Poland hopes to join shortly, has invited members to recall their ambassadors from Iran after a German court ruled that Tehran ordered the 1992 murders of four Kurdish activists in Berlin.
Asked whether Poland would follow this lead, the deputy director of the Warsaw foreign ministry press office, Przemyslaw Antoniewicz, said: "For the time being no".
He said Poland did not feel directly affected by the issue.
"Also, for many months we have not had a Polish ambassador in Iran, there is only a charge d'affaires," he told Reuters.
